1.5 litres equals how many millilitres?
A. 150
B. 1500
C. 15
D. 15000
ANSWER: B

2026 was a leap year. Which answer is correct?
A. True
B. False
C. Unknown
D. Not applicable
ANSWER: B

10 km equals how many metres?
A. 100
B. 1000
C. 10000
D. 100000
ANSWER: C

2-factor authentication is commonly abbreviated as what?
A. 2FA
B. FTP
C. 2D
D. API
ANSWER: A
